channel.description: Latest articles from European Medical Journal (emjreviews.com)

item.title: Vitamin K Antagonists Linked to Lower Short-Term Risk in COPD
item.description: Nationwide cohort data suggest vitamin K antagonists are linked to a lower 1-year risk of severe COPD exacerbation or death compared with DOACs. The post Vitamin K Antagonists Linked to Lower Short-Term Risk in COPD appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Data Support Outpatient Stem-Cell Mobilisation Safety
item.description: A real-world analysis suggests outpatient stem-cell mobilisation in multiple myeloma could safely reduce hospital admissions and bed use through risk stratification and machine learning prediction. The post Data Support Outpatient Stem-Cell Mobilisation Safety appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI Models Combine Genomics and Demographics to Predict Gastric Cancer Risk
item.description: New research shows supervised machine learning models combining Helicobacter pylori genomic data with patient demographics can accurately predict gastric cancer risk. The post AI Models Combine Genomics and Demographics to Predict Gastric Cancer Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Rollout of AI Scribe Tools Transform NHS Consultations
item.description: AI-scribe tools cut admin time, boost patient interaction, and could reshape how NHS clinicians deliver care nationwide. The post Rollout of AI Scribe Tools Transform NHS Consultations appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Immunohistochemical Biomarkers for Prognostic Stratification in Metastatic Prostate Cancer
item.description: New evidence shows PSA and Ki-67 tumour expression may help predict progression and guide treatment decisions in metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer. The post Immunohistochemical Biomarkers for Prognostic Stratification in Metastatic Prostate Cancer appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Mini-Clinical Evaluation Exercise Improves Resident Self-Assessment
item.description: Mini-CEX self-assessment training plus feedback improved dermatology residents’ exam skills and rating alignment well in practice. The post Mini-Clinical Evaluation Exercise Improves Resident Self-Assessment appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Checkpoint-Engineered Particles Induce Food Allergy Tolerance
item.description: Five consecutive daily injections of antigen-specific tVLPs protected mice from allergic symptoms and anaphylactic shock following allergen exposure. The post Checkpoint-Engineered Particles Induce Food Allergy Tolerance appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Do GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Raise Chronic Cough Risk?
item.description: GLP-1 receptor agonists were associated with increased incident chronic cough among adults with type 2 diabetes, in US EHR records. The post Do GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Raise Chronic Cough Risk? appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Prenatal Clues to Situs Inversus Totalis
item.description: Situs inversus totalis diagnosed prenatally plus DNAH11 variants highlights why imaging and genetic testing guide counseling today. The post Prenatal Clues to Situs Inversus Totalis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: GLP-1 RAs Reduce Adverse Limb Events in Patients with Diabetes
item.description: New data show GLP-1 RAs lower amputation, cardiovascular, and mortality risks in diabetes patients with prior limb events. The post GLP-1 RAs Reduce Adverse Limb Events in Patients with Diabetes appeared first on European Medical Journal.
